mergedParams.userDescription: Grunge paper texture stop motion cut-out transition effects between videos

output.title: Grunge Paper Cut-Out Stop Motion Transitions

prompts.prompt: Create a torn paper edge transition preset that simulates stop-motion paper cutouts being ripped away. The outgoing video should appear to be torn from right to left with a jagged paper edge mask, revealing the incoming video underneath. Use a custom SVG mask or clip-path to create the torn paper edge effect. The transition should have a 1.5 second overlap where the paper tear progresses across the screen. Add a subtle paper texture overlay on both videos using a semi-transparent PNG with multiply blend mode. Include a slight rotation wobble on the outgoing video during the tear (2-3 degrees) to simulate hand-held paper movement. The incoming video should have a subtle drop shadow that becomes visible as the paper tears away.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout container with duration = video1.duration + video2.duration - 1.5s overlap. Outgoing VideoAtom starts at 0s with z-10, incoming VideoAtom starts at (video1.duration - 1.5s) with z-0. Use generic transform effect on outgoing video with AnimationRange for rotation from 0deg to 3deg during overlap period, easing 'steps(4)' for stop-motion feel. Apply clip-path animation on outgoing video from 'polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%)' to custom torn edge path. Paper texture ImageAtom overlay with 'absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none opacity-30 mix-blend-multiply'. Drop shadow on incoming video using 'drop-shadow-2xl' class.

prompts.prompt: Design a grunge collage transition where multiple paper scraps slide and rotate chaotically to reveal the next video. Create 5-6 paper scrap shapes using ShapeAtom elements with rough, hand-cut edges. Each scrap should have a different grunge texture and move with unique timing - some sliding left, others rotating and falling. The scraps should have a 2-second staggered animation where they peel away from the outgoing video. Add paper fiber textures and coffee stain overlays to enhance the grunge aesthetic. Include subtle shake effects on both videos during the transition to simulate the rough handling of paper cutouts.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with duration = video1.duration + video2.duration - 2s. Create 6 ShapeAtom elements with custom polygon paths for irregular paper shapes, positioned absolutely with z-20 to z-25. Each ShapeAtom has unique transform animation: translate and rotate with different timings starting from (video1.duration - 2s) with 0.3s stagger. Outgoing VideoAtom with shake effect using transform translateX/Y with random values between -5px and 5px, animation duration 0.1s, repeat 20 times. Grunge texture ImageAtoms with 'mix-blend-overlay opacity-40'. Use 'backdrop-blur-sm' on paper scraps for depth.

prompts.prompt: Build a stop-motion paper fold transition where the outgoing video appears to fold like origami paper, creasing and collapsing to reveal the incoming video. The fold should progress diagonally from top-left to bottom-right corner over 1.8 seconds. Add paper grain texture and subtle shadows along the fold lines to enhance the 3D paper effect. Include a slight bounce effect when the fold completes, as if the paper springs back slightly. The incoming video should have a subtle unfold animation, starting slightly scaled down and expanding to full size.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout duration = video1.duration + video2.duration - 1.8s. Outgoing VideoAtom with 3D transform effect: rotateY from 0deg to -90deg with transform-origin 'left center', combined with skew transform for fold appearance. Use multiple divs with gradient backgrounds to create fold shadow overlays. Incoming VideoAtom starts at scale(0.95) and animates to scale(1) with bounce easing. Paper texture overlay using ImageAtom with 'mix-blend-soft-light opacity-50'. Add CSS perspective on container with 'perspective-1000' class. Timing: outgoing fold starts at (video1.duration - 1.8s), incoming unfold starts 0.3s later.

prompts.prompt: Create a ripped paper strip transition where horizontal strips of the outgoing video are torn away at different speeds, like paper being shredded by hand. Each strip should have rough, fibrous edges and move with stop-motion jerkiness. Add paper fiber particles that float away during the tearing. The strips should reveal the incoming video underneath, which has a subtle paper texture overlay. Include random rotation on each strip as it tears away, simulating manual paper tearing.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with calculated duration for 1.2s overlap. Divide outgoing video into 8 horizontal strips using multiple divs with overflow-hidden and specific height/top values. Each strip contains a shifted VideoAtom copy using negative margin-top for proper alignment. Animate each strip with translateX (alternating left/right), rotate (random -15deg to 15deg), and opacity fade. Use 'steps(3)' easing for stop-motion feel. Incoming VideoAtom at z-0 with paper texture ImageAtom overlay. Add particle divs with 'absolute' positioning, animated with translateY and rotate for floating paper fibers.

prompts.prompt: Design a paper cutout puppet show transition where silhouette cutouts on sticks move across the screen to wipe between videos. Create 3-4 character/object silhouettes that slide in from different edges, each attached to a visible stick. The silhouettes should have a rough, hand-cut quality with slightly wobbly movement. As they cross the screen, they reveal the incoming video behind them. Add a subtle vignette and grain effect to simulate old paper puppet theater aesthetics.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 2.5s overlap period. Create 4 ShapeAtom silhouettes with irregular polygon paths, each with a thin rectangular ShapeAtom for the stick. Position silhouettes off-screen initially. Animate with translateX/Y and slight rotate wobble (±2deg) using 'steps(5)' timing. Silhouettes at z-30 with 'bg-gray-900' fill. Outgoing VideoAtom fades opacity from 1 to 0 during overlap. Incoming VideoAtom at z-0. Add vignette using radial-gradient overlay div. Paper grain ImageAtom with 'mix-blend-screen opacity-20'. Stagger silhouette animations by 0.4s each.

prompts.prompt: Build a paper mosaic transition where the outgoing video breaks into small paper squares that flutter and fall away like confetti. Each square should have a different fall trajectory - some spinning, others drifting sideways. Add paper texture to each square and vary their sizes slightly for a hand-cut feel. The squares should cast subtle shadows as they fall, and the incoming video should be revealed gradually as squares disappear.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 2s overlap. Create 20x15 grid of divs, each containing a clipped portion of outgoing VideoAtom using overflow-hidden and negative margins. Each grid cell has random width/height between 4-6% of container. Animate each square with: translateY (100vh to 150vh), translateX (random -50px to 50px), rotate (random 0deg to 720deg), scale (1 to 0.8). Use different animation durations (0.8s to 1.5s) and delays for organic fall. Add 'shadow-md' to each square. Incoming VideoAtom at z-0. Paper texture on squares using pseudo-element with opacity-30.

prompts.prompt: Create a vintage scrapbook page turn transition where the outgoing video appears pasted on a scrapbook page that curls and flips to reveal the incoming video on the next page. Include decorative paper edges, tape corners, and handwritten annotations that animate during the flip. The page should have a realistic paper texture with slight yellowing and wear marks. Add a subtle 3D perspective effect during the page turn.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 2.2s overlap. Outgoing VideoAtom wrapped in div with 'transform-style-preserve-3d perspective-2000'. Animate rotateY from 0deg to -180deg with transform-origin 'right center'. Add gradient shadow div that follows the page turn. Decorative elements: 4 tape ImageAtoms at corners with 'rotate-3' classes, annotation TextAtoms with handwriting font. Incoming VideoAtom reveals as page turns. Paper texture overlay with 'sepia-20 brightness-95'. Use cubic-bezier(0.645, 0.045, 0.355, 1) for realistic page turn physics.

prompts.prompt: Design a paper shredder transition where vertical strips of the outgoing video get pulled downward as if through a shredder, with each strip moving at slightly different speeds. The strips should curl slightly as they're pulled down, and paper dust particles should emit from the shredding point. The incoming video is revealed from top to bottom as the strips disappear. Include mechanical shredder sound effect sync points.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 1.6s overlap. Divide outgoing video into 12 vertical strips using divs with specific width/left values. Each strip contains VideoAtom with negative margin-left for alignment. Animate strips with: translateY from 0 to 120%, scaleY from 1 to 1.2 (stretching effect), slight rotateX for curl. Stagger animations by 0.1s per strip. Add particle emitter div at shredding line (top of disappearing strips) with small animated divs as paper dust. Incoming VideoAtom with clip-path animation from 'inset(100% 0 0 0)' to 'inset(0 0 0 0)' revealing top to bottom.

prompts.prompt: Build a ransom note style transition where cut-out letters and paper pieces randomly appear and disappear to form a chaotic collage transition. Letters should have different fonts, sizes, and paper textures as if cut from various magazines. They should stick and unstick with tape sound effects, creating a frenetic stop-motion assembly. The pieces eventually clear to reveal the incoming video, with some pieces sticking to the edges of the frame.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 2.8s overlap. Create 15-20 TextAtom elements with random letters/words, each with different font-family, font-size (1rem to 4rem), and rotation (-25deg to 25deg). Position absolutely with random top/left values. Animate each with: opacity (0 to 1 to 0), scale (0.8 to 1.1 to 0), rotate (additional ±10deg wobble). Use 'steps(2)' for jerky movement. Add tape strip divs with 'bg-yellow-200 opacity-60' on some letters. Outgoing VideoAtom fades during overlap. Incoming VideoAtom at z-0. Some letters remain at edges with longer animation duration.

prompts.prompt: Create a paper accordion fold transition where the outgoing video compresses into vertical accordion folds that then expand to reveal the incoming video. Each fold should have realistic shadows and highlights to create depth. The folds should compress and expand with a bouncy, elastic motion. Add subtle paper texture and aging effects to enhance the handmade quality. Include a slight rotation during the fold/unfold for dynamic movement.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 2s overlap. Create 8 vertical sections, alternating between outgoing and incoming video slices. Use transform: scaleX() to compress/expand sections - odd sections scale from 1 to 0.1, even sections from 0.1 to 1. Add gradient overlays for fold shadows: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0,0,0,0.2), transparent, rgba(0,0,0,0.2)). Container rotates from -5deg to 5deg during transition. Use spring physics easing with cubic-bezier(0.68, -0.55, 0.265, 1.55). Paper texture ImageAtom overlay with 'mix-blend-darken opacity-25'. Z-index alternates between sections for proper layering during fold.
